name: Footwraps of the Oracle
label: Quest
description: Footwraps of the Oracle: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.
Bring me the qiraji bindings of command and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.
You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've acquired the items I requested, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well, friend. You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.
I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
